inventory.reason: A4: the isBearerRequest call in the shim (admin-gate-mocks.ts:149-151) replaced by a hardcoded `transport: 'cookie'`. Test still PASSES. PROOF the mutant preserves this test's behaviour: requireAdminWithAal2 reads only identity.authUserId and identity.aal (src/lib/auth/admin-mfa-gate.ts:105-108) and never reads `transport`; the string "transport" occurs in none of the nine folded suites (rg over src/app/api/admin/**/__tests__); and the test asserts only res.status===200 plus the recorded request header. A second mutation on the same test (A5: the Authorization header deleted from the request) was KILLED, so the case is not vacuous — but the killer is the suite's own header assertion, not the shim. See finding F3.

findings.title: The branch's own architecture-review entry states a FALSE production flag state, and that false state is the stated safety premise for the aal1 refusal ADR 0025 makes a hard prerequisite
findings.reason: REJECTED — the claim is true; every source the finding cites is stale. Verified live rather than from a document: `vercel env ls production` (project rep-worth) shows MFA_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED on the Production environment, created 2026-09-08, alongside the staging row. #1182's resolution comment (2026-09-08T23:35Z) records the owner running the production half DIRECTLY from a production-scoped shell after PR #1216 merged, with end-to-end proof (password + TOTP sign-in rendering /admin/overview on production). env-vars.md:653, the log's own #1182 entry, and commit cca34475 all predate that. Stated limit: the Production value is stored Encrypted, so the listing proves presence and creation time, not the literal string; the value is attested by the owner's sign-in. The branch's entry at .claude/reference/arch-review-log.md now cites the ticket and the live check instead of leaning on the stale files, and correcting env-vars.md:653 is cut as a follow-up (it is outside this branch's surface).

findings.title: The audit's new anti-vacuity floor (claim 2) has no covering test — neutering it leaves all 91 audit tests green
findings.reason: FIXED — assertAuditCoverage's process.exit was replaced by the exported pure `auditCoverageFailures(routes, pages): string[]`; main() prints and exits on a non-empty result. Seven tests now assert message CONTENT for all three conditions (traversal error, zero route files, zero pages) plus the healthy case, so the mutation that neutered the floor no longer passes.
findings.arbiter_reasoning: The mutation is semantically meaningful — it removes the whole control claim 2 asserts — but it sits on a branch (main()/assertAuditCoverage) that NO candidate test executes. Per the arbiter rule that is a claim about the ORACLE, not a proven-fake test, so the row is inconclusive/oracle rather than survived-confirmed-P0.

findings.title: The shim's stated bearer guarantee is false: hardcoding `transport` leaves every "bearer ok" route case passing — the header is forced by nine per-suite assertions, not by the shim
findings.reason: FIXED, and re-proven by mutation. Each of the nine folded route suites' bearer case now asserts the transport the shim RESOLVED (`mockResolveDualModeIdentity.mock.results[0]`), and each cookie case asserts 'cookie'. Re-running the original mutation (hardcoding transport) after the fix fails 11 tests across 10 files; before the fix it failed none of the nine. The shim's header no longer claims more than it delivers and names the three suites that prove the real seam without it.
